parsed.why: Adds a birth-sex facility law for all schools/colleges and tightened licence markers, second-highest risk tier, but no enforcement mechanism or arrests; municipal non-discrimination ordinances and employment order partly offset. Near parent.

Top-ranked protective division: public-accommodations protections, protected facility access, hate-crime conviction precedent, easy documents, refuge shield, courts enforcing care. National passport/entry regime still applies, capping the score well below low-risk.

First division to repeal gender-identity civil-rights protection, plus a 2026 bar on stronger local rules; birth-sex facility rule binds all visitors on school grounds; graded in worst group. Below parent.

Statutory gender-identity protections in public accommodations, hate-crime coverage, panic-defence repeal, accessible documents, low-risk tier with youth-only policies. National document/entry regime remains the ceiling; fewer operating facility safeguards than slot 2.

Most restrictive division: executive order assigning all state facilities by birth sex, school facility bans, birth-marker changes barred retroactively, adult public-care ban, no state discrimination or hate-crime coverage. National regime plus local exposure.
